Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# task-06d696f4: aligned panel foreground intersection

The grid is split by a full horizontal separator row. There are two panels with matching dimensions. Output has the dimensions of one panel. At each aligned coordinate, output 2 iff both panel cells are non-background; otherwise output 0. The separator and panel background do not appear in output.

## Confirmed examples
- Demo 1: 15x27 input with separator row of 9; upper panel 7x27 uses background 8 and marker 0; lower 7x27 uses background 0 and marker 7. Output 2 exactly where upper=0 AND lower=7; else 0.
- Demo 2: 15x24 input with separator row 4; upper 7x24 uses background 1, foreground 0; lower 7x24 uses background 6, foreground 0. Output 2 where both panels are foreground; else 0.
- Demo 3: 17x11 input has full separator row of 1 (row index 8). Upper 8x11 background 0, foreground 7; lower 8x11 background 6, foreground 0. Output 2 exactly where upper=7 AND lower=0.
- Successful test: separator row of 6; upper panel background 1, foreground 0; lower panel background 9, foreground 0. Output 2 at aligned coordinates where upper=0 AND lower=0; all other output cells 0.
- Successful recurrence test: input 10x15 with full separator column of 8 (not a horizontal separator). Left panel is 10x7, background 0, foreground 6; right panel is 10x7, background 0, foreground 4. Output is 10x7, 2 wherever aligned cells are simultaneously 6 and 4, otherwise 0. In this test positives were (zero-indexed row, col): (4,5), (5,6), (7,6); importantly multiple same-color markers do not change the cellwise intersection rule.

Update procedure: Locate a full separator line in either orientation. If vertical, compare left/right panels cellwise and output rows matching input height, columns equal panel width. If horizontal, compare top/bottom panels as described above. Emit 2 iff both corresponding cells are non-background; else 0.

## Procedure
1. Find the full separator row and exclude it.
2. Confirm upper and lower panel dimensions match.
3. Identify each panel's background and foreground.
4. For every aligned cell, emit 2 iff both cells differ from their panel backgrounds; otherwise 0.
5. Audit dimensions and every cell. Do not output an all-zero grid or copy one panel.
